hook_lines: just ONE drop and that's it?!

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: One or two drops in the toilet water — a 20ml bottle lasts ~640 uses
Official scents: Sweet Rose, Watery Green, Kinmokusei (osmanthus) — a matcha scent was also on the shelf
Reviews mention frequent repurchasing, and it's been called 'the deodorizer that keeps going viral on social media'
usage_steps: Drop one or two into the water before or after use — no scrubbing needed, the scent spreads on its own

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 변기 물에 한두 방울 떨어뜨리고 향이 퍼지는 걸 확인하는 장면. 손+병+물 웅덩이 위주 클로즈업이면 충분하고 사람 얼굴은 안 나와도 됨, 10~15초 분량.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本1滴消臭元 马桶除臭 使用测评

quotes.japanese: 1滴垂らすだけで、バラの香りがひろがります。消臭スプレーや置き型も併用してますが、これが一番効果あると思います。
quotes.translation: Just one drop and the rose scent spreads. I also use spray and stand-type deodorizers alongside it, but I think this one works best.

quotes.japanese: 個人的にはローズよりグリーンの方が香りが強い気がしますが消臭力は変わらないです。もう手放せないアイテムになりました。
quotes.translation: Personally I feel the Green scent is a bit stronger than Rose, but the deodorizing power is the same either way. This has become something I can't be without.

quotes.japanese: この香りが好きなのと、数滴垂らすだけで（１滴だけ垂らすのがなかなかできなくて。。）悪臭は無くなるので、何度もリピしてます。
quotes.translation: I love the scent, and just a few drops — honestly getting exactly one drop out is surprisingly hard — get rid of the bad smell, so I've repurchased it many times.

quotes.japanese: 良かったです。芳香剤他いろいろ使用していましたが、どれも香りがきつい感じがしていましたが、これは、ほんの一滴で香り良く気持ちいいトイレになりました。今まで知らなかったのが残念でしたわ。
quotes.translation: Really glad I got this. I've tried all sorts of air fresheners and they always felt too strong, but with this one, just a single drop makes for a nice-smelling, pleasant bathroom. Kind of a shame I didn't know about it until now.
